entries.zh: 丢弃；舍去（『去』作除去之词）
entries.en: to discard, to cast away; to put away
entries.notes: M 栏为连读短语（cù: cû paû gì gì buc），切分未定；释义依 H『去』与 L『Desechar』。

entries.en: to cast away, to throw away; to discard
to disdain, to disregard with aversion

entries.zh: 除去；排除（连『嫌』读，谓厌而除之）
entries.en: to remove, to eliminate; to get rid of
to spurn, to eject, to drive off
entries.notes: M 栏『l . pià』未详，疑为异读或旁注，故降等。

entries.en: to abandon, to forsake
entries.notes: M/R 音值与『棄』常读不合，释义依 H 栏字形与 L 栏，故降等。

entries.en: to abandon, to cast off
entries.notes: M『ng say: ùi gì̃』与 R『N̂g』疑为发音人（黃姓）标记而非对音，释义依 L 栏与 H『委』。

entries.en: to decline, to refuse, to reject
entries.notes: L 栏『g los lestren』残损难通，语义依 L 主干『Desechar, no querer』与 H『却』。

entries.en: to disdain, to reject out of dislike
to break off friendship, to sever relations
to be refused, to meet with rejection
entries.notes: 『見』为被动标记；L 栏『loş ledan』残损，故降等。

entries.zh: 丢弃；委弃（字头『委使』与西语不合，疑『委棄』之讹）
entries.en: to abandon, to cast off (headword perh. a scribal variant of 委棄)
entries.notes: H 栏作『委使』，与 L『Desechar』不谐；R 栏『N̂g』疑为发音人标记。

entries.en: to abandon, to let go, to set aside (dar de mano)
entries.notes: 『dar de mano』为 17 世纪『放手、弃置』义；R 栏『N̂g』疑为发音人（黃姓）标记。

entries.en: a cast-off, refuse; a discarded thing
entries.notes: L 栏『azoyado』拼写残损，义当为『被抛掷』，故降等。

entries.en: 〔fragmentary original; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: H、R 两栏均残；L 仅存『Dejambarcar』（疑即 Desembarcar 下船），M『+ joa.』无从定夺。

entries.en: 〔fragmentary original; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L『Defambardar ux』不成词，H 仅存『通』字，R 残；材料不足以定夺。

entries.en: to disembark, to go ashore; to get down
entries.notes: L 末『Lacaja:8.』疑为原稿征引标记（箱/册号），非词义。

entries.en: 〔fragmentary original; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 整行划删；H 疑『屏』或『屁』，L 仅存起首『Dese…』，R『pèng』疑与第 5 条『迸』相混。

entries.en: wharf, landing place, dock
to draw the sword, to unsheathe
entries.notes: H 栏『劍/鉸』有疑，释义依 L『Desembainar la espada』与 M『cūy quiām sìo』（开剑鞘）。

entries.en: to draw out, to pull out (a sword)
to unsheathe the blade, to draw the sword
entries.notes: 『開刀』此处为 17 世纪『拔刀出鞘』义，非现代『动手术』义。
